QUESTS.doneText: The treasure of the Caves is claimed.

objectives.DEFEAT_BRUTE: Slay the Cave Brute that guards the exit portal.
objectives.FIND_KEY: Find the Iron Key in a side chamber of the Caves.
objectives.INTRO: Talk to Eldric by the deep-wilds door to begin.
objectives.OPEN_DOOR: Use the Iron Key on the door locked shut.

QUESTS.summary: Descend into the dungeon beneath the deep wilds, unlock the sealed door and put down the Cave Brute guarding the exit.
QUESTS.title: The Caves of the Deep

QUESTS.doneText: The Forest Ogre is slain — the deep woods can breathe again.
QUESTS.objective: Slay the Forest Ogre that prowls the deep woods.
QUESTS.summary: A Forest Ogre has moved into the deep woods and the surveyor cannot finish his map while it prowls. Kill it.
QUESTS.title: The Surveyor's Errand
